description: Self-protection for the guardrail: denies the agent's file-write tools on the files that configure or run the guard. DISABLED by default (ADR 0006); copy this file into the user policy directory with "enabled": true to activate it. It stops an edit through a write tool only, not a shell redirection, so it raises the cost of switching the guard off and makes the attempt visible; it is not a sandbox (ADR 0015).

policies.title: Block writes to the user policy directory
policies.message: Blocked by guard-self-protection: this file controls the guardrail itself. If the edit is legitimate, the person (not the agent) releases it: make the edit in their own terminal, or set "enabled": false in the active copy of self-protection.policy.json, then enable it again. See docs/standards/lifecycle-guardrails.md#protecting-the-guard-from-the-session.
